mapper.select: SELECT T.TXN_DATE, S.LINE_CODE, T.HANDLE_STATION_CODE, T.DEVICE_ID, T.CARD_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, NVL(SUM(NVL(T.TRX_AMOUNT, 0) + NVL(T.OVERTIME_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS TXN_AMOUNT FROM QRCODE_TXN_DETAIL T LEFT JOIN STATION_INFO S ON S.STATION_CODE = T.HANDLE_STATION_CODE WHERE T.TXN_DATE >= #{startDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.TXN_DATE <= #{endDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.HANDLE_DATE_TIME >= #{windowStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND T.HANDLE_DATE_TIME < #{windowEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY T.TXN_DATE, S.LINE_CODE, T.HANDLE_STATION_CODE, T.DEVICE_ID, T.CARD_TYPE ORDER BY T.TXN_DATE, S.LINE_CODE, T.HANDLE_STATION_CODE, T.DEVICE_ID, T.CARD_TYPE
